## Light effects package — v2

**File:** `packages/camper_light_effects.yaml`

Police is now white / red instead of left / right: both outdoor lights flash together, then both awning reds, 200 ms on / 200 ms off.

Front Flash flashes the front light 3 times.

**Install:** Copy into `<config>/packages/`. Home Assistant only; no relay-board change needed.

This tag marks the version at the public release (2026-11-18). Earlier versions were developed in a private repository; their changelog is in the file header and in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/ysemenikhin/smart-camper-command-center/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
